nodes.label: Workflow: Kotlin legacy (oracle test suite)
nodes.rationale: Temporary: legacy/1ksabord-kotlin is the oracle the TypeScript port of 1000 Sabords is checked against, so its 107 tests must keep passing. Runs jsNodeTest (not check/allTests, which pull jsBrowserTest and would need a headless Chrome) on the committed Gradle 8.7 wrapper, since Gradle 9.x cannot load the Kotlin 2.0.21 plugin.
